the design of a streaming media player that can provide a certain quality of service to the end user.
how to use TFRC to achieve a certain user-perceived media playback quality, and how to determine the optimal TFRC initial buffering delay and the maximum playback rate.

the rebuffering performance of TFRC can be significantly improved if an application is able to determine an appropriate initial buffer delay and media playback rates.
